title: 生命科学
subtitle: Bioscience
teachers:
HIRATA Hiroaki
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: It is highly expected that life sciences may provide a novel driving force for the development of Japanese industry in this century. However, biological technologies are still developing, and often encounter unexpected difficulties in their development. This course will review a range of topics in life sciences, introduce the cutting edge of biological engineering and technologies, and cultivate understanding of the interrelationship between life sciences and human societies.
advice: The lectures in this course are designed for students having knowledge learned in the first and second grade courses including “Basic Biology”, “Structure and Function in Physiology”, “Structure and Function of the Cell”, “Molecular Biology”, “Neuroscience” and “Sensory Information”.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of basic biology, cell biology and molecular biology.

activityGoals.body: Ability to explain the history of life sciences

achievementLevels.ideal:
Be able to explain milestones in life sciences and their significance.
Be able to explain detailed mechanisms for biological evolution.
Be able to explain systematically the flows of genomic and environmental information in the cell.
Be able to explain contributions of life science to human society and their issue.
Be able to explain biotechnologies and their underlying principles that contribute to green innovation.
achievementLevels.standard:
Be able to explain briefly milestones in life sciences.
Be able to explain basic mechanisms for biological evolution.
Be able to explain the basics of the flows of genomic and environmental information in the cell.
Be able to explain briefly contributions of life science to human society.
Be able to explain briefly biotechnologies contributing to green innovation.

              It is highly expected that life sciences may provide a novel driving force for the development of Japanese industry in this century. However, biological technologies are still developing, and often encounter unexpected difficulties in their development. This course will review a range of topics in life sciences, introduce the cutting edge of biological engineering and technologies, and cultivate understanding of the interrelationship between life sciences and human societies.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              The lectures in this course are designed for students having knowledge learned in the first and second grade courses including “Basic Biology”, “Structure and Function in Physiology”, “Structure and Function of the Cell”, “Molecular Biology”, “Neuroscience” and “Sensory Information”.
